thread:
sam_partnerships: FYI — ArmCloud's APAC PO keeps getting rejected by marketplace ingestion. Finance sees an entity mismatch. Customer wants to close this week. Can we triage? :eyes:

anita_finance: Can you paste the PO id and the rejection log? I'll check with procurement.

marketplace-bot: PO ingestion failed: error_code=vendor_entity_mismatch, vendor_name="ArmCloud International", expected_entity="ArmCloud APAC Pty Ltd"

sam_partnerships: PO# 2026-AC-7789. attaching the screengrab from marketplace portal (see link).

claire_marketplaceops: thanks. Marketplace requires the vendor billing entity to exactly match the vendor alias on record. We can patch mapping but procurement requires a signed amendment or alias request from the vendor. Otherwise the ingestion service will reject.

leo_arm: Hey team — Leo from ArmCloud. Our APAC legal ops are on a separate entity. We can issue an authorized alias letter but that usually takes 48-72h. Is there a temporary acceptance path? Customer is stalled on deployment.

raj_legal: Quick read — procurement also flagged a redline in the SOW re: IP assignment that procurement at ArmCloud wants tightened. We can do a one-page amendment that only adjusts the vendor display name for billing; won't touch IP. That should be low friction. I can draft a one-paragraph amendment and send to ArmCloud counsel for e-sign.

gabe_sales: Customer timeline is end of week. If legal can get amendment out today, sales can nudge procurement on their side. Alternate: finance can accept a manual invoice and we backfill the marketplace PO, but that has bookkeeping overhead.

anita_finance: Manual invoice is possible as a last resort, but we prefer marketplace flow for automatic revenue recognition. If legal sends amendment today and procurement signs, finance can update vendor alias and re-run ingestion. ETA depends on ArmCloud counsel.

claire_marketplaceops: Operationally, if you have the exact alias string ArmCloud will use, I can pre-stage the mapping. Format must match exactly (case/punctuation). Example required fields below — if we get these filled we can cut a manual exception ticket that lets ingestion accept the PO while we wait for amendment: 

```
{
  "po_id": "2026-AC-7789",
  "vendor_alias": "ArmCloud APAC Pty Ltd",
  "billing_entity_tax_id": "APAC-XX-12345",
  "contact_email": "finance@armcloud-apac.com"
}
```

leo_arm: Confirmed alias string above is correct. I'll ask our counsel to sign the simple alias amendment. Can Raj share a template?

raj_legal: On it. I'll post a 1-paragraph amendment template in ~45 minutes. Will mark it as vendor-friendly.

marketplace-bot: New ticket created: #MP-4521 "Vendor alias pre-stage for PO 2026-AC-7789" assigned to claire_marketplaceops.

sam_partnerships: Plan then: Raj drafts amendment -> Leo gets counsel sign -> Anita/Finance confirm alias/tax id -> Claire pre-stages mapping and re-runs ingestion -> Gabe keeps customer updated. If any slippage we fall back to manual invoice.

gabe_sales: I'll message the customer and set expectations. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

claire_marketplaceops: I'll update the MP ticket with ingestion logs and coordinate with eng if we need a manual override.

anita_finance: Add me to the MP ticket once pre-stage is done. I need the signed amendment for audit.

leo_arm: Thanks everyone — we'll prioritize. I'll report back within 24h.

sam_partnerships: Great — ping here as soon as signed amendment or if counsel asks for changes.

raj_legal: Draft posted to the ticket and DM'd Leo.

marketplace-bot: Ticket #MP-4521 status: in_progress -> awaiting_vendor_signature
